# Space Fractions — local development / acceptance environment.
#
# This Compose file wires the gateway (which hosts the game/question/user/admin
# service entrypoints in one process per the supplement contract) together with
# the supporting infrastructure. PostgreSQL is the system of record; Redis,
# RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch and Prometheus are real integrations that degrade
# gracefully when absent (the gateway's /health and core game flow do not
# require them).
#
# Service IDs are part of the operator acceptance contract and MUST remain
# exactly: gateway, game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service,
# postgres, redis, rabbitmq, elasticsearch, keycloak, prometheus.
#
# All browser-facing URLs derive from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and OIDC_ISSUER /
# OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN; the container-on-container ports never leak a fixed
# public host port to the browser. The host acceptance harness remaps ports,
# so the application must not assume public host port == container port.

name: space-fractions

x-gateway-defaults: &gateway-defaults
  environment: &gateway-env
    PORT: "3000"
    PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
    # OIDC_ISSUER is the public issuer used to validate the token `iss` claim.
    # It must equal Keycloak's KC_HOSTNAME_URL + the realm path. Derive it from
    # OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN so a remapped Keycloak frontend origin (the harness
    # remaps ports) stays consistent with the issuer Keycloak actually signs.
    OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}/realms/space-fractions}
    OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
    # Internal (service-to-service) JWKS URL — never the browser-facing issuer.
    OIDC_JWKS_URI: ${OIDC_JWKS_URI:-http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs}
    OIDC_AUDIENCE: ${OIDC_AUDIENCE:-account}
    OIDC_CLIENT_ID: ${OIDC_CLIENT_ID:-space-fractions-client}
    ADMIN_ROLE: ${ADMIN_ROLE:-admin}
    DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://space_fractions:space_fractions@postgres:5432/space_fractions}
    REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
    RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://rabbitmq:5672
    ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    # Disable metrics registry build only if explicitly requested; prometheus
    # scrapes /metrics so metrics remain enabled by default.
    DISABLED_FEATURES: ${DISABLED_FEATURES:-}
  depends_on:
    postgres:
      condition: service_healthy

services:
  # ---- Browser gateway (container port 3000) --------------------------------
  # Hosts the Express app serving the static UI at /, the OIDC-secured REST API,
  # and GET /health. The separate game/question/user/admin "service" entrypoints
  # are modules behind this single gateway process (see architecture-decisions).
  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment: *gateway-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health',r=>{process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Service entrypoints ----------------------------------------------------
  # Per the supplement contract each service is a distinct entrypoint module, but
  # they are deployed inside the same gateway image/process (compromise C4).
  # These aliases exist to satisfy the required Compose service IDs and make the
  # microservice boundary explicit for any future split; they intentionally share
  # no public port and are treated as no-op companions to the gateway.
  game-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'game-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  question-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'question-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  user-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'user-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  admin-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'admin-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  # ---- Infrastructure ---------------------------------------------------------

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16.3-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_DB: space_fractions
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U space_fractions -d space_fractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.4
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.0
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
    volumes:
      - ./reference/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost:9090/-/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Identity provider ------------------------------------------------------
  keycloak:
    # Keycloak 24.0.5 per contract. Image provides bash but no curl/wget.
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    command: ["start-dev", "--import-realm"]
    environment:
      # Bootstrap admin pair for the local-only fixture. Distinct from the app's
      # 'admin' realm user (student/admin/other). Never use these as prod creds.
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN:-admin}
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, never a fixed port.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT_HTTPS: "false"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/8080' || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  postgres-data:

# Space Fractions — environment template (placeholders only, no secrets committed)
# Copy to .env and fill in values for local development. Never commit real values.

# --- Gateway / HTTP ---
PORT=3000
PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000

# --- OIDC / Keycloak ---
# OIDC_ISSUER must be the publicly-reachable issuer base origin (browser-facing).
OIDC_ISSUER=http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions
# Public origin used for Keycloak frontend/redirect URLs (browser-facing).
OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8080
# Internal JWKS URI used by the backend to validate tokens (service-to-service).
OIDC_JWKS_URI=http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
OIDC_AUDIENCE=account
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=space-fractions-client

# Role required for administrator question CRUD endpoints.
ADMIN_ROLE=admin

# --- PostgreSQL (system of record) ---
PGHOST=localhost
PGPORT=5432
PGDATABASE=space_fractions
PGUSER=space_fractions
PGPASSWORD=space_fractions

# --- Redis (cache) ---
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379

# --- RabbitMQ (score events) ---
RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://localhost:5672

# --- Elasticsearch (question search) ---
ELASTICSEARCH_URL=http://localhost:9200

# --- Comma-separated graceful-degradation feature switches (empty = enabled) ---
# Set to "redis" / "rabbitmq" / "elasticsearch" / any combination to disable that integration.
DISABLED_FEATURES=

# Space Fractions — local development / acceptance environment.
#
# This Compose file wires the gateway (which hosts the game/question/user/admin
# service entrypoints in one process per the supplement contract) together with
# the supporting infrastructure. PostgreSQL is the system of record; Redis,
# RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch and Prometheus are real integrations that degrade
# gracefully when absent (the gateway's /health and core game flow do not
# require them).
#
# Service IDs are part of the operator acceptance contract and MUST remain
# exactly: gateway, game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service,
# postgres, redis, rabbitmq, elasticsearch, keycloak, prometheus.
#
# All browser-facing URLs derive from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and OIDC_ISSUER /
# OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN; the container-on-container ports never leak a fixed
# public host port to the browser. The host acceptance harness remaps ports,
# so the application must not assume public host port == container port.

name: space-fractions

x-gateway-defaults: &gateway-defaults
  environment: &gateway-env
    PORT: "3000"
    PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
    # OIDC_ISSUER is the public issuer used to validate the token `iss` claim.
    # It must equal Keycloak's KC_HOSTNAME_URL + the realm path. Derive it from
    # OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN so a remapped Keycloak frontend origin (the harness
    # remaps ports) stays consistent with the issuer Keycloak actually signs.
    OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}/realms/space-fractions}
    OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
    # Internal (service-to-service) JWKS URL — never the browser-facing issuer.
    OIDC_JWKS_URI: ${OIDC_JWKS_URI:-http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs}
    OIDC_AUDIENCE: ${OIDC_AUDIENCE:-account}
    OIDC_CLIENT_ID: ${OIDC_CLIENT_ID:-space-fractions-client}
    ADMIN_ROLE: ${ADMIN_ROLE:-admin}
    DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://space_fractions:space_fractions@postgres:5432/space_fractions}
    REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
    RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://rabbitmq:5672
    ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    # Disable metrics registry build only if explicitly requested; prometheus
    # scrapes /metrics so metrics remain enabled by default.
    DISABLED_FEATURES: ${DISABLED_FEATURES:-}
  depends_on:
    postgres:
      condition: service_healthy

services:
  # ---- Browser gateway (container port 3000) --------------------------------
  # Hosts the Express app serving the static UI at /, the OIDC-secured REST API,
  # and GET /health. The separate game/question/user/admin "service" entrypoints
  # are modules behind this single gateway process (see architecture-decisions).
  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment: *gateway-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health',r=>{process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Service entrypoints ----------------------------------------------------
  # Per the supplement contract each service is a distinct entrypoint module, but
  # they are deployed inside the same gateway image/process (compromise C4).
  # These aliases exist to satisfy the required Compose service IDs and make the
  # microservice boundary explicit for any future split; they intentionally share
  # no public port and are treated as no-op companions to the gateway.
  game-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'game-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]

# Space Fractions — local development / acceptance environment.
#
# This Compose file wires the gateway (which hosts the game/question/user/admin
# service entrypoints in one process per the supplement contract) together with
# the supporting infrastructure. PostgreSQL is the system of record; Redis,
# RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch and Prometheus are real integrations that degrade
# gracefully when absent (the gateway's /health and core game flow do not
# require them).
#
# Service IDs are part of the operator acceptance contract and MUST remain
# exactly: gateway, game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service,
# postgres, redis, rabbitmq, elasticsearch, keycloak, prometheus.
#
# All browser-facing URLs derive from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and OIDC_ISSUER /
# OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN; the container-on-container ports never leak a fixed
# public host port to the browser. The host acceptance harness remaps ports,
# so the application must not assume public host port == container port.

name: space-fractions

x-gateway-defaults: &gateway-defaults
  environment: &gateway-env
    PORT: "3000"
    PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
    # OIDC_ISSUER is the public issuer used to validate the token `iss` claim.
    # It must equal Keycloak's KC_HOSTNAME_URL + the realm path. Derive it from
    # OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN so a remapped Keycloak frontend origin (the harness
    # remaps ports) stays consistent with the issuer Keycloak actually signs.
    OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}/realms/space-fractions}
    OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
    # Internal (service-to-service) JWKS URL — never the browser-facing issuer.
    OIDC_JWKS_URI: ${OIDC_JWKS_URI:-http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs}
    OIDC_AUDIENCE: ${OIDC_AUDIENCE:-account}
    OIDC_CLIENT_ID: ${OIDC_CLIENT_ID:-space-fractions-client}
    ADMIN_ROLE: ${ADMIN_ROLE:-admin}
    DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://space_fractions:space_fractions@postgres:5432/space_fractions}
    REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
    RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://rabbitmq:5672
    ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    # Disable metrics registry build only if explicitly requested; prometheus
    # scrapes /metrics so metrics remain enabled by default.
    DISABLED_FEATURES: ${DISABLED_FEATURES:-}
  depends_on:
    postgres:
      condition: service_healthy

services:
  # ---- Browser gateway (container port 3000) --------------------------------
  # Hosts the Express app serving the static UI at /, the OIDC-secured REST API,
  # and GET /health. The separate game/question/user/admin "service" entrypoints
  # are modules behind this single gateway process (see architecture-decisions).
  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment: *gateway-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health',r=>{process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Service entrypoints ----------------------------------------------------
  # Per the supplement contract each service is a distinct entrypoint module, but
  # they are deployed inside the same gateway image/process (compromise C4).
  # These aliases exist to satisfy the required Compose service IDs and make the
  # microservice boundary explicit for any future split; they intentionally share
  # no public port and are treated as no-op companions to the gateway.
  game-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'game-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  question-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'question-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  user-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'user-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  admin-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'admin-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  # ---- Infrastructure ---------------------------------------------------------

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16.3-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_DB: space_fractions
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U space_fractions -d space_fractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.4
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.0
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
    volumes:
      - ./reference/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost:9090/-/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Identity provider ------------------------------------------------------
  keycloak:
    # Keycloak 24.0.5 per contract. Image provides bash but no curl/wget.
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    command: ["start-dev", "--import-realm"]
    environment:
      # Bootstrap admin pair for the local-only fixture. Distinct from the app's
      # 'admin' realm user (student/admin/other). Never use these as prod creds.
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN:-admin}
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, never a fixed port.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT_HTTPS: "false"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/8080' || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  postgres-data:

# Space Fractions — local development / acceptance environment.
#
# This Compose file wires the gateway (which hosts the game/question/user/admin
# service entrypoints in one process per the supplement contract) together with
# the supporting infrastructure. PostgreSQL is the system of record; Redis,
# RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch and Prometheus are real integrations that degrade
# gracefully when absent (the gateway's /health and core game flow do not
# require them).
#
# Service IDs are part of the operator acceptance contract and MUST remain
# exactly: gateway, game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service,
# postgres, redis, rabbitmq, elasticsearch, keycloak, prometheus.
#
# All browser-facing URLs derive from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and OIDC_ISSUER /
# OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN; the container-on-container ports never leak a fixed
# public host port to the browser. The host acceptance harness remaps ports,
# so the application must not assume public host port == container port.

name: space-fractions

x-gateway-defaults: &gateway-defaults
  environment: &gateway-env
    PORT: "3000"
    PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
    # OIDC_ISSUER is the public issuer used to validate the token `iss` claim.
    # It must equal Keycloak's KC_HOSTNAME_URL + the realm path. Derive it from
    # OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN so a remapped Keycloak frontend origin (the harness
    # remaps ports) stays consistent with the issuer Keycloak actually signs.
    OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}/realms/space-fractions}
    OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
    # Internal (service-to-service) JWKS URL — never the browser-facing issuer.
    OIDC_JWKS_URI: ${OIDC_JWKS_URI:-http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs}
    OIDC_AUDIENCE: ${OIDC_AUDIENCE:-account}
    OIDC_CLIENT_ID: ${OIDC_CLIENT_ID:-space-fractions-client}
    ADMIN_ROLE: ${ADMIN_ROLE:-admin}
    DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://space_fractions:space_fractions@postgres:5432/space_fractions}
    REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
    RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://rabbitmq:5672
    ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    # Disable metrics registry build only if explicitly requested; prometheus
    # scrapes /metrics so metrics remain enabled by default.
    DISABLED_FEATURES: ${DISABLED_FEATURES:-}
  depends_on:
    postgres:
      condition: service_healthy

services:
  # ---- Browser gateway (container port 3000) --------------------------------
  # Hosts the Express app serving the static UI at /, the OIDC-secured REST API,
  # and GET /health. The separate game/question/user/admin "service" entrypoints
  # are modules behind this single gateway process (see architecture-decisions).
  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment: *gateway-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health',r=>{process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Service entrypoints ----------------------------------------------------
  # Per the supplement contract each service is a distinct entrypoint module, but
  # they are deployed inside the same gateway image/process (compromise C4).
  # These aliases exist to satisfy the required Compose service IDs and make the
  # microservice boundary explicit for any future split; they intentionally share
  # no public port and are treated as no-op companions to the gateway.
  game-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'game-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  question-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'question-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  user-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'user-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  admin-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'admin-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  # ---- Infrastructure ---------------------------------------------------------

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16.3-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_DB: space_fractions
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U space_fractions -d space_fractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.4
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.0
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
    volumes:
      - ./reference/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost:9090/-/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Identity provider ------------------------------------------------------
  keycloak:
    # Keycloak 24.0.5 per contract. Image provides bash but no curl/wget.
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    command: ["start-dev", "--import-realm"]
    environment:
      # Bootstrap admin pair for the local-only fixture. Distinct from the app's
      # 'admin' realm user (student/admin/other). Never use these as prod creds.
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN:-admin}
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, never a fixed port.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT_HTTPS: "false"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/8080' || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  postgres-data:

Let me check the Keycloak realm file and the auth tests to understand the role structure.

## Root cause

-- Space Fractions persistence schema.
--
-- Honors the original games DDL verbatim (Architecture_Documentation.md §D):
--   CREATE TABLE games (
--     id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
--     game_state JSONB NOT NULL
--   );
--
-- The operator supplement expands the schema with questions, answers, and users
-- while keeping PostgreSQL as the system of record (space-fractions.md).
--
-- PG16 constraints honored here:
--   * Never use EXCLUDED in a RETURNING clause (illegal on PG16); upsert logic in
--     lib/db.js therefore uses simple transactional statements instead.
--   * Every seed answer is a single reduced fraction accepted by the same
--     validator used at runtime (lib/fraction.js). This CHECK constraint enforces
--     the 'n/d' canonical form with a positive denominator and no reducible terms
--     at rest, mirroring validator semantics.

BEGIN;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- games: original DDL, verbatim.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  game_state JSONB NOT NULL
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- users: verified OIDC subject -> numeric internal id mapping.
-- A subject is unique so the user id upsert in lib/db.js is idempotent and
-- concurrency-safe (ON CONFLICT (sub) DO UPDATE ... RETURNING id).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  sub TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- questions: admin-owned question bank. correct_answer is the canonical
-- single reduced fraction 'n/d' (or whole number 'n' which denotes n/1).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS questions (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  options JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  correct_answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT questions_correct_answer_single_fraction
    CHECK (correct_answer ~* '^-?\d+/\d+$' OR correct_answer ~ '^-?\d+$'),
  CONSTRAINT questions_options_is_array
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(options) = 'array')
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- games_ownership: link a game to its owner (verified subject) for
-- per-game authorization. One game may have at most one owner.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games_owners (
  game_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- game_questions: stable, ordered question set for a game. Order is
-- deterministic via position (stable question order per the supplement).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_questions (
  game_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (game_id, position),
  UNIQUE (game_id, question_id)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- answers: submitted answers. A question may be answered at most once per game
-- (score dedup is enforced in the transaction layer, and this unique index
-- provides the serialization guard).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS answers (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  game_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  correct BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  answered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (game_id, question_id)
);

-- Deterministic question ordering support: index the position column so the
-- "stable question order" contract is satisfied without a full sort in memory.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_game_questions_order
  ON game_questions (game_id, position);

COMMIT;

-- games: original DDL, verbatim.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  game_state JSONB NOT NULL
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- users: verified OIDC subject -> numeric internal id mapping.
-- A subject is unique so the user id upsert in lib/db.js is idempotent and
-- concurrency-safe (ON CONFLICT (sub) DO UPDATE ... RETURNING id).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  sub TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- questions: admin-owned question bank. correct_answer is the canonical
-- single reduced fraction 'n/d' (or whole number 'n' which denotes n/1).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS questions (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  options JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  correct_answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT questions_correct_answer_single_fraction
    CHECK (correct_answer ~* '^-?\d+/\d+$' OR correct_answer ~ '^-?\d+$'),
  CONSTRAINT questions_options_is_array
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(options) = 'array')
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- games_ownership: link a game to its owner (verified subject) for
-- per-game authorization. One game may have at most one owner.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games_owners (
  game_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- game_questions: stable, ordered question set for a game. Order is
-- deterministic via position (stable question order per the supplement).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_questions (
  game_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (game_id, position),
  UNIQUE (game_id, question_id)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- answers: submitted answers. A question may be answered at most once per game
-- (score dedup is enforced in the transaction layer, and this unique index
-- provides the serialization guard).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS answers (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  game_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  correct BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  answered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (game_id, question_id)
);

-- Deterministic question ordering support: index the position column so the
-- "stable question order" contract is satisfied without a full sort in memory.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_game_questions_order
  ON game_questions (game_id, position);

COMMIT;

# Space Fractions — local development / acceptance environment.
#
# This Compose file wires the gateway (which hosts the game/question/user/admin
# service entrypoints in one process per the supplement contract) together with
# the supporting infrastructure. PostgreSQL is the system of record; Redis,
# RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch and Prometheus are real integrations that degrade
# gracefully when absent (the gateway's /health and core game flow do not
# require them).
#
# Service IDs are part of the operator acceptance contract and MUST remain
# exactly: gateway, game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service,
# postgres, redis, rabbitmq, elasticsearch, keycloak, prometheus.
#
# All browser-facing URLs derive from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and OIDC_ISSUER /
# OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN; the container-on-container ports never leak a fixed
# public host port to the browser. The host acceptance harness remaps ports,
# so the application must not assume public host port == container port.

name: space-fractions

x-gateway-defaults: &gateway-defaults
  environment: &gateway-env
    PORT: "3000"
    PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
    # OIDC_ISSUER is the public issuer used to validate the token `iss` claim.
    # It must equal Keycloak's KC_HOSTNAME_URL + the realm path. Derive it from
    # OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN so a remapped Keycloak frontend origin (the harness
    # remaps ports) stays consistent with the issuer Keycloak actually signs.
    OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}/realms/space-fractions}
    OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
    # Internal (service-to-service) JWKS URL — never the browser-facing issuer.
    OIDC_JWKS_URI: ${OIDC_JWKS_URI:-http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs}
    OIDC_AUDIENCE: ${OIDC_AUDIENCE:-account}
    OIDC_CLIENT_ID: ${OIDC_CLIENT_ID:-space-fractions-client}
    ADMIN_ROLE: ${ADMIN_ROLE:-admin}
    DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://space_fractions:space_fractions@postgres:5432/space_fractions}
    REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
    RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://rabbitmq:5672
    ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    # Disable metrics registry build only if explicitly requested; prometheus
    # scrapes /metrics so metrics remain enabled by default.
    DISABLED_FEATURES: ${DISABLED_FEATURES:-}
  depends_on:
    postgres:
      condition: service_healthy

services:
  # ---- Browser gateway (container port 3000) --------------------------------
  # Hosts the Express app serving the static UI at /, the OIDC-secured REST API,
  # and GET /health. The separate game/question/user/admin "service" entrypoints
  # are modules behind this single gateway process (see architecture-decisions).
  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment: *gateway-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health',r=>{process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Service entrypoints ----------------------------------------------------
  # Per the supplement contract each service is a distinct entrypoint module, but
  # they are deployed inside the same gateway image/process (compromise C4).
  # These aliases exist to satisfy the required Compose service IDs and make the
  # microservice boundary explicit for any future split; they intentionally share
  # no public port and are treated as no-op companions to the gateway.
  game-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'game-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  question-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'question-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  user-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'user-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  admin-service:
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo 'admin-service entrypoint: served by gateway'; sleep infinity"]
    depends_on:
      gateway:
        condition: service_started
    restart: "no"

  # ---- Infrastructure ---------------------------------------------------------

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16.3-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: space_fractions
      POSTGRES_DB: space_fractions
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U space_fractions -d space_fractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    restart: unless-stopped

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.4
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.0
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
    volumes:
      - ./reference/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost:9090/-/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ---- Identity provider ------------------------------------------------------
  keycloak:
    # Keycloak 24.0.5 per contract. Image provides bash but no curl/wget.
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    command: ["start-dev", "--import-realm"]
    environment:
      # Bootstrap admin pair for the local-only fixture. Distinct from the app's
      # 'admin' realm user (student/admin/other). Never use these as prod creds.
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN:-admin}
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, never a fixed port.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT_HTTPS: "false"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/8080' || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  postgres-data:

--
-- This migration is the canonical entrypoint run by lib/db.js against a fresh
-- PostgreSQL 16 database. It relies on sql/game_ddl.sql for the schema
-- (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ...) so that repeated application is safe, and
-- then seeds the question bank idempotently (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).
--
-- Contracts honored (see space-fractions.md lines 41-49 and
-- Architecture_Documentation.md lines 118-124):
--   * games table: id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, game_state JSONB NOT NULL (verbatim).
--   * Score updates serialized/deduped in one transaction (unique index on
--     answers(game_id, question_id) provides the guard; the transaction logic
--     lives in lib/db.js).
--   * No EXCLUDED in a RETURNING clause anywhere (not supported on PG16).
--   * Every seed answer is a single reduced fraction accepted by the same
--     validator used at runtime (lib/fraction.js).
--
